title: Reading Answer Review
changes: Fixed Reading-from-Meaning questions moving on almost immediately after a wrong answer.
Incorrect answers now keep Sensei's correction, the correct Japanese reading, written word and English meaning visible until the learner chooses Continue.
The correct pronunciation is replayed during the review and remains available through the speaker button.
The mistake is still recorded immediately and Adaptive Learning can still schedule its normal delayed repair question.
Bumped the Kaishi Quest shell and image cache version so existing users receive the corrected release.
